samples.question: Begin with the direction shown by the white arrow in the purple tile. Follow the touching tiles in alternating row order: left-to-right, then right-to-left, then left-to-right, then right-to-left. Gold means turn clockwise by one quarter turn; teal means reflect the direction across a vertical mirror, swapping east with west while keeping north and south. What is the final compass direction?
